# Valluvam

> Valluvam is an Indian food products brand selling nuts, dry fruits, cold-pressed oils,
> spices, millets and rice — for individual households (B2C) and for businesses buying
> in bulk (B2B / wholesale). Valluvam is part of the IGO Group.

## What Valluvam sells

- Nuts: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/nuts.php
- Dry Fruits: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/dryfruits.php
- Cold-Pressed Oils: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/oils.php
- Spices: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/spices.php
- Millets: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/millets.php
- Rice: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/rice.php
- Combo packs: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/combo.php
- Full shop: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/shop.php

## Business

- Homepage: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/

- B2B / Wholesale supply (retailers, hotels, restaurants, caterers, distributors,
  institutions, bulk buyers): https://www.valluvamproducts.com/b2b-wholesale.php
- Contact: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/contact.php

## Policies

- Returns and Exchange: https://www.valluvamproducts.com/return.php

## Delivery

Valluvam ships across India via its online store, with order status tracking
available from order placement through delivery.
